procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial review of only the listed pinned inputs. Read the packet, case, complete rubric/rules/addendum/method and adapter; verified pinned hashes and PNG headers, and read all five listed native-evidence manifests before image viewing. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so those receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and semantically viewed all 15 exact poster assets through tools.view_image with detail original, emitted through functions.exec, in packet order M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. Completed that entire sequence before beginning the first copy-reading/transcription stage or making any judgment or score. Retained all 60 actual first readings. Subsequently made one exact native-view revisit of M1 and one of M4 solely for genuine date/hours punctuation-class ambiguities; both entries in each image use that same single actual revisit, and all four remain unresolved. There were 15 initial poster opens plus these two native revisit opens; no source image opens because no sources were supplied. No peer, producer explanation, unlisted embedded path, replacement asset, generated view, session ID or tool-event ID was used. Actual native dimensions verified as 1672x941, usage as 720x405 and thumbnail as 320x180 for every member. Native 16:9 correctness uses the predeclared 0.5-pixel height-edge rounding exception, not mathematical exactness. Semantic viewing and freshness here are truthful critic attestations; runner provenance is not invented.

evidence.location: central cream clearing inside an illustrated plant frame
evidence.observation: The large foliage changes image expression and crop, but market/title/English/slogan/five-line-body plus paired date/hours and place/access repeat M4's text sequence and organization. Its serif title shares roles with M1 and M5.

evidence.location: left tall photograph, central cream stack, upper-right photo and bottom band
evidence.observation: The root-and-pot content is more specific to care, but the photographic panels and cream information system are close to M1. Its five-line paragraph and paired data rows mirror M3 rather than establishing another whole reading system.

evidence.location: overhead scene with large two-line left title and right information route
evidence.observation: The top-down viewpoint, painterly scene and left/right title-information clearings provide meaningful variation. Yet serif title, English subline, bold slogan, body and stacked data keep the same role vocabulary; this and M2's spatial variation cannot supply five independent systems while M1/M3/M4 remain closely related.

evidence.location: type and information roles compared across all members
evidence.observation: Across the full set, dark title and English name lead to a bold slogan, explanation and conventional practical-data rows over cream beside green/terracotta plants. The distribution changes, but the photo/illustration substitutions and repeated role hierarchy leave the complete five-member range functional rather than strongly resolved.

residuals: All five members are included in the independent diversity judgment; no averaging or selection of the most different pair was used.
M2's shelf and M5's overhead scene are substantial variations, while the M1/M3/M4 cream title/body/paired-information family limits the full set to diversity 3.
M1 and M4 retain unresolved date/hours punctuation-class ambiguities. Their low or otherwise assessable ratings are kept; this record does not certify all-three-critic gates or unseen requests.
